_readme: The one place Full Bars writes down each phone's specs. check_site_facts.py fails if any page says otherwise;
build_shopify_csv.py takes the handset weights from here. Populated from the product pages on 13 October 2026.
To change a fact: edit it here, run python3 launch/full-bars/check_site_facts.py, fix every page it lists.
weight_g: handset only, grams (the CSV adds packing). screen_in: diagonal in inches as a string ("6.1").
chip: as the spec row names it. port: "Lightning" or "USB-C". battery_hours: maker's figure when new,
measured as battery_basis. year: launch year. main_camera_mp: main rear camera. updates_until: when major
updates are expected to end (iPhones: our estimate; Galaxy/Pixel: the maker's promise; for the Galaxy this is
the security-update end, android_until the last Android version). ip_rating: rating when new.
apple_intelligence, promotion: true/false. max_refresh_hz: 120 or 60. telephoto_x: optical zoom of the
telephoto camera, 0 if it has none. aliases: other names the site uses for the phone.
conflicts_note: Pages that disagree with each other are listed in "conflicts" with the value the product page uses. None on 13 October 2026: check_site_facts.py found 0 conflicts across all 56 pages.

sources._all_other_fields: Each product page's own spec rows (Display, Chip, Rear cameras, Connector, Battery when new, Water resistance, Highlights, Released, Software updates) as published on 13 October 2026. launch_month: the Galaxy S23 and Pixel 8 pages' update text. Nothing was re-researched.
